programs.description: A businessman returns to his homeland to reconcile with his friend. Soon, upon learning of his friend's plight, he becomes a crusader for the farmers in the village.
An honest police officer lives with his mother, stepfather and stepbrother. When a criminal, who intends to join politics, lures his stepbrother into the world of crime, he must go against him.
Rakthaksha, a tantric, has a confrontation with Jayamma when the latter decides to build a temple on a piece of land which was meant to be a place for conducting sacrifice.
When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.
A radio jockey, Pradip, falls for Tanu, a devoted fan of his show. However, as her wedding approaches, he battles his emotions, torn between love and the reality of her commitment.
Upon hearing about his father's plight, a young NRI from London decides to visit his native village and mend a long-standing family feud.
Enraged by her daughter's decision to elope with her lover, a notorious gangster separates the couple. However, the woman is devastated to find her lover in a deranged state after several years.
While the occurrence of a series of mysterious deaths haunt the villagers, a man decides to risk his life and unravel the secret behind them.
A police officer tries to change his younger brother, who turns to a life of crime, but he fails. He then takes on the local gangster responsible for inciting youngsters towards crime.
A young politician has devious plans to advance his career. However, he suddenly develops a conscientious alter ego that interferes with his crooked efforts.
While the occurrence of a series of mysterious deaths haunt the villagers, a man decides to risk his life and unravel the secret behind them.
Jai Simha Reddy, the son of the esteemed Veera Simha Reddy, returns home to avenge his father's death as a result of village politics.
After the death of his mother, Lucky encounters a group of friendly ghosts. When he learns that the ghosts died due to financial crisis, he agrees to help them find peace by robbing a bank with them.
Indrasen and Shivraj's families are rivals residing in a village. However, one day, the people of the village seek Indrasen's help to build a water reservoir, but he is stopped by his enemy, Shivraj.

Waltair Veerayya, a fisherman and smuggler, is in dire need of money in order to fight a court case. Later, he is approached by an officer to extradite Solomon Caesar, an infamous drug lord for money.
After the COVID-19 pandemic hits Sri Lanka, a family travels to India to begin a new life. Their arrival quickly transforms their new neighbourhood.
A man and his family are uprooted from their community in Sri Lanka and wind up as bonded labourers in Visakhapatnam. Soon, he rises up to become the saviour of the oppressed.
The exiled prince Raghav embarks on a perilous journey to rescue his wife, Janaki, from the clutches of the demon king Lankesh. He must gather an army to wage an epic battle against evil forces.
After the COVID-19 pandemic hits Sri Lanka, a family travels to India to begin a new life. Their arrival quickly transforms their new neighbourhood.
An orphaned boy takes up a personal challenge to attend school and get educated. However, while trying to complete this goal, he faces numerous hardships on his way.
Renu, Akka, Didi and Chanchala are four friends from college who face several adversities in life. However, they find one way or another to live their life to the fullest.
Vijay, a gentle lecturer, unintentionally offends Geetha, a strong-willed woman and works to mend their relationship by proving his sincerity and intentions.
A smuggling kingpin faces off against a vengeful rival while manipulating politics, making big deals and navigating tense confrontations.
A junior artist named Anila is roped into a plan to bring together a broken family. However, he stumbles upon a powerful secret of theirs that involves black magic and the supernatural.

A young woman named Anna is kidnapped by a few men who then proceed to torture her. However, Anna's situation takes a turn when a great power possesses her.

Bhudevipuram has a long history of families warring over ancestral property. However, when its headman's family falls into the same trap, his younger son decides to break the village's age-old legacy.
A junior artist named Anila is roped into a plan to bring together a broken family. However, he stumbles upon a powerful secret of theirs that involves black magic and the supernatural.
Reeling from a sad breakup, a college student gives up on his studies to commit financial fraud. However, his new endeavour puts him in a difficult spot.
After succeeding at framing ACP Kishore, Satya goes on to become an international criminal. While he gets targeted by Interpol, Kishore seeks revenge on him too, upon being released from prison.
Desperate to bring his family out of monetary woes, Bhaskar Kumar, a bank employee, enters the dangerous and murky world of financial scams.
A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.
Fiery officer Potharaju Shankar faces off against three dangerous outlaws. Meanwhile, their fierce feud quickly leads to unexpected consequences for everyone involved.

When he arrives in the city to earn a living, Yadhunandhan is helped by Mayakka, a gangster, who also gives him a place to live. When she is killed by a rival gang, Yadhunandhan decides to avenge her.
Lakshminarayana, a CBI officer, is drawn into a dangerous conspiracy when his wife Priya vanishes after discovering hidden weapons, leading him on a mission that uncovers shocking truths.
Fiery officer Potharaju Shankar faces off against three dangerous outlaws. Meanwhile, their fierce feud quickly leads to unexpected consequences for everyone involved.
Young Surya holds Agni, his father and DGP, responsible for his mother and sister's deaths. Years later, he becomes a corrupt IPS officer and decides to take revenge against his father.
Bringing the best in cinema.
Arya, a free-spirited guy, relentlessly tries to woo Geethanjali, the girlfriend of a college rowdy, Ajay. However, when the couple faces trouble, Arya steps in to help them.
Athishay, an aspiring music director, gets married to Anu despite their contrasting partner preferences. Later, they continue the pursuit of their soulmates.
A former convict must help save a battery of poisoned policemen by taking them to the hospital, while being hunted by a gang of criminals, in exchange for meeting his daughter for the first time.
Three cousins, Divya, Krishnan and Arjuna, share a close bond and decide to move to Bangalore to fulfil their childhood dreams. There, they face challenges that will change their lives forever.
An intelligent and ambitious youngster arrives in Mumbai and becomes a mafia don, but one day, things take turn when he falls in love with a cop's daughter.
A former convict must help save a battery of poisoned policemen by taking them to the hospital, while being hunted by a gang of criminals, in exchange for meeting his daughter for the first time.
Kailash and Urvashi's relationship remains unfulfilled due to a tragedy in their past lives. Years later, Kailash's friend Vishwas tries to reunite the lovers in their present births.
Ambi, a retired stunt master, sets out on a heartfelt journey to reconnect with his lost love, facing unexpected challenges and rediscovering his purpose along the way.
A criminal frames a police officer for a murder he did not commit. When the cop gets killed, his brother decides to settle the score.
A local thief, who lives in the village of Anjanadri, comes across a Hanuman-like power. He must protect people from the peril that looms over them.
With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.
Satya slips into a coma after undergoing a face transplant after an accident where his face is damaged and his lover Deepthi dies. On waking up, he decides to avenge her death.
The grandson of a rich businessman promises to reunite him with his estranged daughter and enters their home in disguise. However, he has to deal with several challenges to keep his promise.
With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.
After his mother's death and father's arrest, Sathya brings up his seven sisters like a father. But a villainous character from his father's past turns the siblings against each other.
Brothers Raj and Shankar choose opposing paths after goons murder their father. Raj turns outlaw seeking vengeance, Shankar joins the police force.
An NRI medical student and a vivacious young woman fall in love with each other. However, their personal differences and misunderstandings create a distance between them.
After Rayudu and Ranjith Reddy's children elope, the CMs turn against each other. However, when a college student kidnaps Reddy's daughter, a revenge saga unravels.
A novice postmaster in Rangpur unexpectedly becomes entangled in the complex lives of local sex workers, challenging his preconceptions.
Gurudev Hoysala, a morally upright police inspector, is transferred to Athani to investigate a fellow officer's disappearance. However, a suspicious young couple soon complicates the case.
A sportsman travelling to a village for a match saves a woman from a brutal factionist. The latter pursues them, but he refuses to back down from the confrontation, changing his life forever.
A novice postmaster in Rangpur unexpectedly becomes entangled in the complex lives of local sex workers, challenging his preconceptions.
Shalini, a police commissioner's daughter, mistakes Anand for a criminal and gets him arrested with her father's help. Later, Anand rescues Shalini from a group of gangsters.
A sinister man tries to defame the village landlord and create trouble for the village. However, the landlord is determined to stand tough against all the allegations.
Agastya, an automobile mechanic with a dangerous past, takes it upon himself to protect Nithya, a kidnapped girl, from the vengeful son of a ruthless gangster.
Raja, a visually impaired young man, steps in to save Lucky from a gangster's deadly pursuit. Subsequently, touched by his unwavering courage and kindness, Lucky falls in love.
Muruga, an invincible hunter known for killing man-eating tigers, unknowingly becomes a part of a conspiracy surrounding illegal drugs and struggles to protect his family.
